newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA pref stock up on Bank Austria offer. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CA pref stock up on Bank Austria offer. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]

text.p: Creditanstalt preference shares were up 2.65 percent in the last half hour of trade in Vienna after Bank Austria said it would offer owners of the stock to exchange their shares for those of Bank Austria.
The stock was up 11.05 schillings at 429 on turnover of 133,700 lots, more than six times its average daily trading volume. The ATX was steady at 1,168.31 points the same time.

Bank Austria was awarded the state's 70 percent voting stake in rival Creditanstalt on Sunday. Uncertainty over the fate of the preference shares had knocked almost 15 percent off the share's value since Monday.
Small holders of ordinary voting shares are eligible for an alternative cash offer of 722.50 per share up to a total holding of 200,000 schillings (corrects from "200,000 shares").
